title: The Vanished Manuscript
short_description: A rare manuscript was swapped for a forgery in the archive room. Three staff had reason to be near.
incident_report: Between 21:10 and 21:20 last night, a rare medieval manuscript in the archive room was swapped for a convincing forgery. Nothing was forced. Three staff members had legitimate reason to be nearby: Mara (senior archivist), Idris (curator), and Lena (conservator). The forgery was only discovered this morning.

read_incident_report.observation: A rare manuscript was swapped for a forgery in the archive room between 21:10 and 21:20. No forced entry. Staff of interest: Mara (archivist), Idris (curator), Lena (conservator).

archive_room.observation: Access log for the archive: a single entry at 21:17 using Mara's card. No other entries during the window. Idris's card was last used at 20:40 in the main hall.

evidence.description: Mara's access card opened the archive at 21:17 — inside the incident window.
Idris's card was in the main hall at 20:40; he never entered the archive during the window.

archive_room.observation: Hallway camera at 21:16 shows Mara approaching the archive door carrying a flat manuscript case. No one else appears in frame during the window.

evidence.description: Camera places Mara at the archive door at 21:16 carrying a flat case.

archive_room.observation: The display case was opened without force. In the bin: a shredded printout of a forged provenance letter — someone was covering up a forgery. Also found: Lena's library request slip, but dated the previous day.

evidence.description: Shredded forged provenance letter in the bin — the swap was meant to hide a forgery.
Lena's request slip was present but dated the previous day — a coincidence, not incident-related.

access_card.observation: The reader shows Mara's badge ID was duplicated: the same ID badged in two buildings five minutes apart. The duplicate opened the archive, letting her enter without logging her real badge.

evidence.description: Mara used a copied access card to enter the archive off the books.

manuscript_case.observation: The forgery was slipped in using a manuscript case only archivists handle. Fibers on the case match Mara's gloves.

evidence.description: The forgery was placed with an archivist's case; fibers match Mara.

mara.observation: Mara says she left the building at 21:00 and did not return.

raises_question.note: Mara claims she left at 21:00 — but the badge log says 21:17. Verify.

evidence.description: Mara claims she left at 21:00 and never returned.

idris.observation: Idris says he was cataloguing in the main hall all evening.

evidence.description: Idris says he was in the main hall all evening.

lena.observation: Lena says she had already gone home; she resents Mara over a past dispute but denies any involvement.

evidence.description: Lena resents Mara but says she was already home (unrelated grudge).

mara.observation: Mara's claim that she left at 21:00 is false: her badge and the hallway camera both place her at the archive at 21:16-21:17.

evidence.description: Mara's alibi is false; she was present at the moment of the swap.

idris.observation: Idris's alibi checks out: two colleagues confirm he was in the main hall.

evidence.description: Idris's main-hall alibi is corroborated by two colleagues.

idris|mara.observation: Mara claims she left at 21:00; Idris and the badge log contradict her. Idris's account is consistent.

evidence.description: Mara's account conflicts with the badge log; Idris's is consistent.
